title: EnrollmentConfig
description: Organizer-supplied workshop enrollment config. Topic prefixes and consumer group prefixes are derived automatically as hive.<workshop_id>.<attendee_id>.

workshop_id.description: Workshop identifier, e.g. hive-1. Used to derive topic and consumer group prefixes.

attendee_id.description: Unique attendee identifier, e.g. queen-001. Combined with workshop_id to form topic prefix hive.<workshop_id>.<attendee_id>.

access_token.description: Plaintext workshop access token issued to the attendee, e.g. token-001.
